blocked_features: Model/STT spend ceiling is not implemented, so video intake is documented as disabled.

Live Yandex ID login is not verified.
Several roadmap decision flags are stale/blocked relative to implemented code; readiness must follow current completion receipts rather than roadmap counts.
deployment_blockers: The actual compose expects an external talk-ai-public network; a fresh VM cannot boot it unchanged unless that network exists.
The documented production deployment mentions docker-compose.prod.yml, but no such file exists; docker-compose.yml is the runnable manifest.
Migrations are a separate mandatory operation and are not run by compose.
Application images are not prebuilt or registry-addressable in the manifest; CloudruHub must build them from source or receive separately published images.
The Caddy and PostgreSQL tags are not digest-pinned.

suggested_minimum.basis: PostgreSQL plus four Node processes; no object storage. This is not load-tested sizing.

blocked_features: MAX messenger integration is not implemented.
Guest reply channel FR-008 is not implemented.
Weekly share/metrics and active-point reporting are incomplete.
Partner share/codes and attribution are incomplete.

Production YooKassa shop and several live webhook/device checks are unverified.
deployment_blockers: SESSION_SECRET is required by guest device hashing but is absent from guest.environment in compose; documented G-13 says protection is not reproducible until the manifest is fixed.
DATABASE_URL_MIGRATE is required operationally but absent from .env.example and compose by design; migration is an explicit one-off step.
The stack has no edge proxy and requires the external talk-ai-public network plus a trusted proxy host; a fresh standalone VM cannot expose the app unchanged.
TELEGRAM_BOT_USERNAME is consumed by compose/code but absent from .env.example.
Dockerfiles use an npm ci-or-install fallback and install tsx globally at build time, so builds depend on live registries and are not fully deterministic.
Application images are source builds only; no registry image coordinates are declared.

suggested_minimum.basis: Compose limits total 384 MiB PostgreSQL + 512 MiB API + 4 x 128 MiB frontends = 1408 MiB before Docker/OS overhead. Two GiB is a tight floor for all variants, not load-tested sizing.

blocked_features: Root fixture pages and payments are synthetic; they are not production money.
Current VPS YooKassa integration is disabled and no real merchant sandbox/live operation has been run.
Autopayout/split payments are not implemented; payouts remain manual.
Streaming, push notifications, background scheduler, conversational continuation, and built-in LLM are not implemented.
Specialized A-D UIs remain fixture demonstrations; real /account functionality is shared.
deployment_blockers: README explicitly warns that HEAD contains unfinished F3 access-onboarding code and says not to rebuild the stand from HEAD; the known deployed source was f8055e3.
No immutable image receipts or registry image coordinates for the current requested baseline are present in the runnable manifests.
All variant frontends require external network talk-ai-public; a fresh VM cannot start them unchanged without the edge network/proxy.
Required runtime secret files are intentionally absent and must be provisioned with restrictive permissions.
Deploying only one A-D variant would be a product-scope decision; the repository's accepted full F1 surface is all four variants.

suggested_minimum.basis: Next.js SSR, API, recognizer, PostgreSQL, MinIO photo storage, Caddy build/runtime, and local USDA import. Increase disk for retained photos and database growth. This is not load-tested sizing.

blocked_features: Real-money acceptance is not live; documented stand uses YooKassa test mode.
Automatic partner payouts are not implemented and require a separate contract/business setup.
Telegram login has not been verified live with the owner's account.
deployment_blockers: .env.example omits five compose-required variables: N4_SUBSCRIPTION_PRICE_MINOR, N4_SUBSCRIPTION_PERIOD_DAYS, N4_COMMISSION_HOLD_DAYS, N4_SCAN_LIMIT_PRO, and N4_PAYMENTS_MODE; copying it verbatim cannot render the edge compose profile.
The edge profile requires the external talk-ai-public network and upstream proxy integration.
Migrations and USDA/synonym data loading are separate mandatory bootstrap operations.
No n4 application images are installed locally or published by immutable registry coordinate in compose; app/proxy images must be built.
The proxy image name uses :local; source Dockerfile pins base images but the built output itself has no immutable distribution receipt.

global_blockers: This artifact is repository inventory only and does not claim any VM, CloudruHub, DNS, TLS, backup, restore, firewall, or live application work.
None of the four apps has a directly consumable set of immutable application image coordinates in the inspected production manifests.
All four were designed around the existing shared talk-ai-public edge network; Cloud.ru deployment must reproduce that topology or adapt the manifests before boot.
No paid action or external resource mutation was performed.
